activity_summary: By noon the street had cried tomorrow, on Tower Hill. You heard it from the stair and did not go down. Today's bill was still up. You left Verbeke at his thread.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the crier and the door.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Asked after today's bill, and left Verbeke at his work.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the cry up the stair.

entities.name: Tower Hill
entities.context: Mentioned in Tomorrow, on Tower Hill

facets.activity: Heard tomorrow cried on Tower Hill
